proposition: EvidenceState::is_actionable returns true exactly for EvidenceState::Actionable.
non_claims: This claim does not establish correctness of evidence production, severity assignment, or downstream command execution.
This claim does not establish whole-program correctness or specification adequacy.
domain: All five registered EvidenceState variants selected by a bounded symbolic index.
assumptions: The symbolic index is constrained below the five registered EvidenceState variants.
trust_dependencies: CBMC solver execution and result reporting
the pinned Rust verifier toolchain and target configuration
negative_controls: Mutation control: make a non-Actionable variant return true and require the harness to fail.
result_satisfaction: One current verified row for the registered subject with both required covers satisfied and no unreachable cover.
currentness_inputs: provider, solver and Rust toolchain identity
runner generation and effective verifier configuration
actual admitted merge-group and ordered member heads
transition_policy: base_and_head_remain_protected_until_an_explicit_generation-bumped replacement or recorded retirement is accepted
